subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker after the Tool Search subset is fixed, or should maintainers split the remaining non-wrapper long-session behavior into a narrower issue?
rationale: The evidence is split across overlapping but distinct failure modes, and only maintainers can choose whether to keep one umbrella tracker or close it once the narrower linked fix lands with live proof.

options.title: Keep as canonical tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until a long-session replay proves Tool Search, write, exec, and provider-stream paths no longer drop arguments.

options.title: Split after Tool Search fix
options.body: After a Tool Search fix lands, close or narrow this only if a new issue captures any remaining provider-stream or session-state drift with concrete logs.

options.title: Close on subset fix
options.body: Treat the Tool Search fix as sufficient once merged, accepting the risk that the original write/exec long-session class may need a new report.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a long-session replay proves Tool Search, write, exec, and provider-stream paths no longer drop arguments.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a broad core runtime and product-triage boundary choice, and the current baseline/history makes @steipete the best available routing candidate from the likely owner list.
